endCall.configDescription: Configure the behavior when the call ends
endCall.toolNameHint: A descriptive name for this tool
endCall.descriptionHint: Helps the LLM understand when to use this tool
endCall.descriptionPlaceholder: When should the AI end the call?
endCall.captureReasonHint: When enabled, the AI will provide a reason for ending the call. The reason will be set as the call disposition and added to call tags for analytics.
endCall.reasonDescriptionHint: Instructions shown to the AI for what kind of reason to provide
endCall.reasonPlaceholder: e.g., The reason for ending the call (e.g., 'voicemail_detected', 'issue_resolved', 'customer_requested')

endCall.noMessageHint: End the call immediately without any message
endCall.customMessageHint: Play a custom message before disconnecting

endCall.prerecordedAudioHint: Play a pre-recorded audio file before disconnecting

httpApi.configDescription: Configure the HTTP API endpoint and request settings
httpApi.hostnameParamsDetected: Hostname parameters detected: {params}. Values resolve from tool call arguments or workflow context at runtime.
httpApi.pathParamsDetected: Path parameters detected: {params}. Values resolve from tool call arguments or workflow context at runtime.
httpApi.customMessageHint: Optional message the AI will speak or play before executing this tool.
httpApi.customMessagePlaceholder: e.g., Let me check that for you, one moment please.
httpApi.llmParametersHint: Define the parameters that the LLM will provide when calling this tool. These will be sent in the request body for POST/PUT/PATCH or as URL query params for GET/DELETE.
httpApi.presetParametersHintBeforeCode: Add values that Dograh should inject at runtime. These are not exposed to the LLM and can use workflow templates like
httpApi.bodyFormatHint: How the request body is encoded. Use form-encoded only for APIs that reject JSON; lists repeat the field name and objects are sent as JSON strings.
httpApi.bodyTemplateHint: Shape the request body with a JSON template.
httpApi.customHeadersHint: Add custom headers to include in the request (optional)

transferAgent.configDescription: Hands the live call to another agent. The caller stays connected, hears a ringer while the next agent is prepared, and the conversation so far is passed on as a handover note.
transferAgent.toolNameHint: Also becomes the function name the agent calls. Name it after the destination, e.g. “Transfer to Billing”.
transferAgent.descriptionHint: This is what the agent decides on. To offer more than one destination, add a second transfer tool with its own description.
transferAgent.descriptionPlaceholder: Use when the caller asks about an invoice, a payment or their balance
transferAgent.handoverMessageHint: Spoken in the current agent's own voice, and waited for before the caller is handed over. Leave empty to hand over without saying anything.
transferAgent.handoverMessagePlaceholder: Let me connect you with the right person. One moment please.
transferAgent.playGreetingHint: Turn off to have the next agent continue the conversation instead of introducing itself. It then opens with a reply based on the handover note.

transferCall.configDescription: Configure call transfer settings. Supports phone numbers (Twilio, Plivo) and SIP endpoints (Asterisk ARI).
transferCall.toolNameHint: A descriptive name for this tool
transferCall.descriptionHint: Helps the LLM understand when to use this tool
transferCall.descriptionPlaceholder: When should the AI transfer the call?
transferCall.preTransferMessageHint: Choose whether to play a configured message before transferring. In dynamic mode, resolver custom_message overrides this when returned.
transferCall.noMessageHint: Transfer the call immediately without any message
transferCall.customMessageHint: Play a custom message before transferring
transferCall.customMessagePlaceholder: e.g., Please hold while I transfer your call.
transferCall.prerecordedAudioHint: Play a pre-recorded audio file before transferring
transferCall.introductionEnabled: Play a transfer introduction to both parties
transferCall.introductionHint: Briefly summarise the call in your agent's voice before connecting both parties. Whoever answers the destination hears the summary. Available on Twilio using your configured TTS provider. Realtime speech-to-speech agents skip the introduction. If it cannot be prepared, the transfer continues.
transferCall.introductionPromptHint: Specify details to include and the language, such as Brazilian Portuguese. Your TTS voice must support that language. Introductions are limited to 25 words and 15 seconds and cannot be interrupted by speech.
transferCall.timeoutHint: Maximum time to wait for destination to answer after the transfer starts (5-120 seconds)
transferCall.callDispositionHint: Optional. This value is recorded only when the transfer succeeds. Leave blank to use the default transfer disposition.
transferCall.destinationSourceHint: Choose a configured destination, ordered context rules, or an HTTP resolver.
transferCall.transferDestinationHint: Use a fixed number, SIP endpoint, or context template.
transferCall.dynamicResolverHint: Dograh sends the resolved argument dictionary to this endpoint. The endpoint must return transfer_context.destination and may return transfer_context.custom_message.
transferCall.resolverUrlHint: Dograh sends a POST request with the resolved argument dictionary.
transferCall.resolverCredentialHint: Select a credential for the resolver endpoint, or leave empty for no auth.
transferCall.resolverWaitMessagePlaceholder: One moment while I find the right team.
transferCall.resolverWaitMessageHint: Spoken while Dograh waits for the resolver response.
transferCall.llmParametersHint: Define values the agent should provide when calling this transfer tool, such as state, department, or reason.
transferCall.presetParametersHintBeforeCode: Add values Dograh injects at runtime. These are not exposed to the LLM and can use templates like
transferCall.customHeadersHint: Add custom headers for authentication or routing metadata.
transferCall.contextRulesHint: Rules are evaluated top to bottom. The first matching value selects its destination; matching ignores case and surrounding whitespace.
transferCall.contextFieldHint4: . Use an explicit prefix to read only one context.
transferCall.destinationsHintBeforeCode: Destinations can be a SIP endpoint, E.164 PSTN number, another provider-supported destination, or a template such as
transferCall.addAtLeastOneRoutingRule: Add at least one routing rule.
transferCall.fallbackDestinationHint: Used only when no rule above matched.

testDialog.llmParametersHint: Values the model would provide at call time.
testDialog.presetParametersHint: Resolved values that Dograh would normally derive from each configured preset.
testDialog.editDescription: Edit the JSON value sent for this parameter when testing.
